About

Owner-led grounds maintenance in Kelowna.

Black Mountain Maintenance was founded by Rob Thompson, who brings years of experience in commercial grounds maintenance and client account management. We keep our client list focused so every property gets consistent, detail-oriented care, with direct access to the owner whenever you need it.

Rob studied Geography and started out as an environmental technologist, then spent ten years in landscaping in Fort McMurray: two running his own company, Keep It Green, and eight as a partner in Creative Industries, which is still going strong today. He lives in Kelowna with his wife and their two boys.
